description: "A Sketch of the Causes, Operations and Results of the San Francisco Vigilance Committee in 1856" by Stephen Palfrey Webb is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This book explores the emergence and activities of the Vigilance Committee in San Francisco, which arose in response to rampant crime and corruption in the city during a period marked by the Gold Rush and a chaotic influx of settlers.
